As of today (September 4, 2026) a domestic large accelerated filer must file its Form 10‑K within 60 calendar days after the fiscal year‑end. See the SEC’s rule release on accelerated filing deadlines. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/rules-regulations/2005/12/revisions-accelerated-filer-definition-accelerated-deadlines-filing-periodic-reports?utm_source=openai))
